relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.evidence: He graduated from the College of the Holy Cross in Worcester, Massachusetts, with a Bachelor of Arts, cum laude, in philosophy and religious studies in 1979.

relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.evidence: He then earned a Master of Arts in Indian philosophy from McMaster University in 1984.

relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.evidence: In 1991, Powers earned his Ph.D. in Buddhist studies from the University of Virginia.

relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.evidence: In 1987 Powers was appointed adjunct professor in the Department of Philosophy and Religion at Virginia Commonwealth University, Richmond, Virginia.

relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.role: Kiriyama Chair of Pacific Rim Studies
relations.evidence: He was briefly Kiriyama Chair of Pacific Rim Studies at the University of San Francisco in 1995.

relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.evidence: Powers was appointed senior lecturer at the Australian National University in late 1995.

relations.subject: C. John Powers
relations.evidence: In 2022, Powers was appointed to the University of Melbourne as lecturer in Buddhism Studies.
